en: Colorized vintage view over a European town with red-tiled roofs, seen from an elevated vantage point. On the right stands a prominent stone building with a clock tower and spire facing an open square with a few trees and pedestrians. The background shows flat countryside and scattered buildings. German text is printed at the top: the town name on the left and a caption on the right.
